Lead.title: Lead
Lead.description: Voluntary email capture recorded when a user sends their diagnostic report PDF via email. Contains no PHI or diagnostic answers.

email.description: Recipient email voluntarily provided by the user to receive their PDF report.

timestamp.description: Server timestamp recorded when the report email was sent.

/leads/{leadId}.description: Stores voluntary report delivery leads (timestamp, email, report_id) with zero PHI or diagnostic answers.
